SoundDesigner v1.0.3 brings a more compact workspace, better library navigation, and new ways to find and shape sound in Premiere Pro and After Effects.

### New

- **Cloud SFX library:** search alongside your local library, identify cloud sounds by their icon, and prepare downloads for preview and insertion. Cloud availability depends on the service's catalogue and connection.
- **SFX Assistant for After Effects:** analyze animation moments, review sound suggestions, audition alternatives, and place approved sounds with timing controls.
- **Favorites collections:** organize favorite sounds into your own nested collections and choose a destination when saving. Favorites remains accessible across library folders.
- **Waveform grid:** switch between list and compact tiles, adjust tile size, and keep your preferred view.
- **Quick FX:** peak Normalize, Echo and Room controls, alongside gain, pitch, speed and reverse. Preview changes, bypass them, or reset before inserting.
- **Optional hover audition:** listen while browsing; playback stops when the pointer leaves.

### A more compact workspace

- The waveform and playback controls now share a bottom player dock, leaving more room for results.
- FX opens in a compact floating panel; sound details and browse options are available on demand.
- Keep the Library sidebar pinned, resize it, and retain its pin/width preferences.
- Navigate compact folder trees with expandable branches, complete-name tooltips and recursive audio counts.
- Clicking a pinned folder reveals its original location in the tree.
- Search stays scoped to the selected folder, with **Include subfolders enabled by default** and an explicit All sounds option.

### Fixes and refinements

- FX and other popovers remain above the sidebar instead of being obscured by it.
- Improved narrow-dock layout, control alignment, long-path tooltips and keyboard focus handling.
- Unanalysed audio uses a neutral placeholder until real waveform data is available; cached real peaks are retained.
- Large libraries use virtualized results and prioritize visible waveform analysis.
- Improved cloud connection fallback and error reporting across CEP environments.
- Removed misleading relevance percentages; the space now goes to sound names and waveforms.
- Fixed the active Reverse indicator for selected audio segments.

### Download and install

Download **SoundDesigner-v1.0.3.zxp** below and install it with your ZXP installer, then restart the Adobe application.

Existing installations can use **Settings → Updates → Check now**, or wait for the next automatic update check. Updates are downloaded and installed by the user; the extension does not silently replace itself.

The CEP package targets Premiere Pro and After Effects on macOS and Windows. SFX Assistant is currently available in After Effects. Room is a lightweight reflection effect; noise reduction is not included.

[Full source changes](https://github.com/iboyshanto/SoundDesigner/compare/v1.0.2...v1.0.3)
